name: typeflow-web
description: 文镇 TypeFlow 网页版 — 阶段 0 算法事实冻结与一致性验证（自包含，可整体迁出为独立仓库）

scripts.test: tsx engine/tests/compare.ts && tsx engine/tests/stage1.ts && tsx engine/tests/stage2.ts && tsx engine/tests/cff-stage1.ts && tsx engine/tests/regression.ts
scripts.cf:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --local
scripts.cf:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --remote
scripts.cf:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.portal:test: tsx --tsconfig portal/tsconfig.json portal/tests/backup.test.ts && tsx --tsconfig portal/tsconfig.json portal/tests/delivery.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run webcrypto && npm run smoke && npm run recipe && npm run worker:test && npm run worker:test:d1 && npm run worker:test:entry && npm run worker:integration && npm run portal:test && npm run e2e && npm run portal:e2e:full
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:signer
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run webcrypto && npm run smoke && npm run e2e
